ValidationRule.description: A qualified Opportunity cannot return to the Sales Stage
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(StageName), NOT(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName),"Sales Chance")), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Sales Chance"), Not($Permission.QualifyOpp), Not($Permission.BypassValidations) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Once qualified, Sales Chances must be set to a different Stage.
